'''Heavy Republic flame throwers''' were a type of [[heavy weapon]] [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A variant was the '''Malevolent flamethrower'''.<ref name="TOW" />
